content: {"episode_id":"ep-05001","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, under Reason Code CO-197 for precertification or prior authorization not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease, consistent with diagnosis codes I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91. Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 738.30 on this basis."}
